from datetime import datetime

def calculate_time_difference(event_time, current_time, time_format):
    event_time = datetime.strptime(event_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    current_time = datetime.strptime(current_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    
    time_diff = event_time - current_time
    hours, remainder = divmod(time_diff.seconds, 3600)
    minutes, _ = divmod(remainder, 60)
    
    return f"{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}"

event_time = "2024-05-15 12:30:00"
current_time = "2024-05-15 10:30:00"
time_format = "HH:MM"

time_diff = calculate_time_difference(event_time, current_time, time_format)
print(f"The time difference is {time_diff}")
